captions.detailed: This object is a model of a tilt-and-slide moonroof cassette system. It consists of a large, flat, rectangular outer frame in a matte light gray finish, featuring longitudinal side tracks. Nestled inside is a dark tinted glass panel framed in black. The glass panel is designed to tilt upward from its rear edge and slide backward along the tracks to open.
captions.instruction: Generate a tilt-and-slide moonroof cassette with a light gray outer frame and a dark tinted glass panel. The frame should contain parallel guide tracks, and the glass panel should be engineered to tilt up at the rear and slide along the tracks.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject starting with a base frame ('cassette') modeled using Box primitives for the side rails and crossmembers. It then creates the sliding mechanism and glass panel ('moonroof_glass') using layered Box shapes. To enable motion, a prismatic joint is defined along the longitudinal axis of the guide rails, coupled with a revolute joint to simulate the rear-edge tilt action.
